mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y/Y GDPC1 growth accelerates by >1pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in >40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in the unemployment rate below 5% signals a tightening labor market that will drive wage inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the Fed tightens policy.
failure_condition: UNRATE drops below 5% but SPX 20-day returns are positive >60% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production, as measured by the year-over-year change in INDPRO, signals a supply shock that will drive inflation and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y/Y INDPRO growth drops >2pp but SPX 60-day returns are positive >40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When the housing starts series HOUST rises above a 12-month high, it signals a strengthening housing market that will boost consumer spending and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST rises to a 12-month high but SPX 20-day returns are negative >40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate FEDFUNDS is above 4% and rising, it signals a tightening monetary policy that will slow economic growth and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 4% and rising but SPX 60-day returns are positive >40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures RSAFS are rising faster than the CPI inflation rate, it signals strong real consumer demand that will boost corporate revenues and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: RSAFS growth > CPI growth but SPX 20-day returns are negative >40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate UNRATE is below 4% and payroll employment PAYEMS is rising, it signals a tight labor market that will drive wage inflation and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as the Fed tightens policy.
failure_condition: UNRATE < 4% and PAYEMS rising but SPX 60-day returns are positive >40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production INDPRO is falling and the CPI inflation rate is rising, it signals a stagflationary environment that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO falling and CPI rising but SPX 60-day returns are positive >40% of the time.
